title: Kernel estimates and weak (1,1)-boundedness of pseudo-differential operators on compact Lie groups
summary: Given a compact Lie group $G$ and its unitary dual $\widehat{G}$, we establish the weak (1,1) continuity for pseudo-differential operators in the global Hörmander classes of order $-n(1-ρ)/2$ on $G\times \widehat{G}$. Our approach consists of proving suitable estimates for the kernel of such operators. Furthermore, we use these kernel estimates to give an alternative proof for the $H^1(G)$-$L^1(G)$-continuity of these classes now allowing the full range $0\leqδ\leqρ\leq1, \;ρ\neq0,\;δ\neq1$.
